blocking_defects.defect: The first 3.66 s (s1-shot-1 room-wall-wide) contain only a lighting fade (clockState light .38 to 1 over s1-event-1, 0.48 to 1.43 s) and the name plate settling (s1-event-2, 2.06 to 3.16 s). blocking_defects.defect: The opening 3.66 s is an establishing room plus a name plate. The cameras do not act until 3.89 s, and the selected opening action (camera stamps the entry) is absent from s1.
'Patient entry' is stamped on the gurney-to-table transfer, which the paper names as a different event. The real roll-in happened unstamped in s1.
At the s2 to s3 cut an undraped identical patient appears on the table, the reset sheet vanishes, and the draping repeats, with no arrival or disclosure of a next case.
The placebo row draws 12 units against the paper's 11 and encodes an unclaimed second-place rank.
The camera lamps dim (an unsourced shutdown inference), and the closing picture asks a new turnover question without any trace of the added cases it should answer.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain, from code (not observed): in a generic illustrated Houston cardiothoracic operating room, four wall cameras light and watch a gurney roll in. A wall clock ring is stamped by pulses from a camera at entry, draping and turnover. A draped patient triggers an amber 'Patient draped' text on a surgeon's phone. A study card shows the suite line pulling away from other Houston Methodist sites while 25 case tiles pour into a tray. A 7 percent badge and a 8.3 to 41.0 interval whisker follow, then a placebo row with a 'short of conventional significance' stamp and an 'associated, not caused' card with a struck 'caused' arrow. Bundled review notes and a minority stake ring come next, then a future-work card tagging turnover, and finally a blank turnover box as the camera lamps dim.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on 'Does a camera that logs an operating room add surgeries, or only count them?' over a room that only brightens. The answer actually arrives at s7 (about 25 more, associated rather than caused). The film then closes on a blank turnover box and dimming camera lamps. As built, the close asks whether turnover sped up rather than visibly tying that open question back to the 25 added cases, and the dimming lamps add an unsupported implication that the cameras were switched off.
story_review.weakest_transition: s2 to s3 (12.48 s). The draped patient is rolled out and the table reset with a fresh sheet. Then, with no arrival, an identical undraped patient lies on a sheetless table and is draped again under 'It also texted the surgeon when the patient was draped'. The declared bridge (the Draped marker lifts off the ring as the phone lights) is not implemented.
